# (the trace -> fixture -> test pattern: docs/design/V3_REPLAY_TESTS.md).
#
# Every `logged-*` line is MEASURED: copied verbatim from the kf3 log of the named boot. Everything
# else is a regression-fixture input derived from those lines, labelled so:
#   measured  = a region the log names (the slot that hit the ceiling, its left neighbour);
#   synthetic = a filler slot the log does NOT name. The log gives the free blocks, so the used spans
#               are their complement; `span OFF CAP N` splits one used span into N filler slots
#               (N-1 of slot_default runs, the last takes the rest). Only the spans are derived from
#               the log; the split inside a span is invented and does not change any decision here.
# This is not a captured per-die table: it is one pool layout and one growth request, replayed.
#
# Evidence (not committed: the qemu logs hold the host GPU UUID): /workspace/bench/pc_wukong_20261115/

# geometry line). Boots: image A offline, Black Myth: Wukong benchmark, FG off, fb-mb 4096, Very High.
# Line numbers are of the `qemu_<boot>_copy.log` copy.
